tasks.prompt: What systems are affected if J12 changes?
tasks.expected_answer: Direct blast radius: MCB-C4 PCB footprint/pin map, CHS-240 opening, J12 BOM/supplier record, HAR-J12-C and WI-114, motor_ctrl.c GPIO_17/ADC3 mapping, QA-FIX-C adapter, and power/final QA validation.

tasks.prompt: Why is HAR-J12-B incompatible with Rev C?
tasks.expected_answer: Rev B has two circuits for power only. Rev C MCB-C4 and 43025-0400 require four circuits; pins 3 and 4 carry GPIO_17 MOTOR_PWR_EN and ADC3 MOTOR_PWR_SENSE. QA-FIX-C also expects both.

tasks.prompt: What constrains the current 8 kg payload rating?
tasks.expected_answer: The MTR-24-220 has only 14% observed torque margin at 8 kg and peak current is 7.4 A against the MCTRL-8A 8.0 A ceiling. The chassis GVW limit is 22.5 kg versus 22.2 kg at rated payload.
